headline: PROSPECTOR METALS ML26-56: 41.34 G/T GOLD OVER 7.81M — TESS ZONE KEEPS WIDENING AT YUKON ML PROJECT
snippet: Prospector Metals Corp. (TSXV: PMCO) released hole ML26-56 from the Tess Zone at its ML Project in Yukon, returning 41.34 g/t gold over 7.81 metres — among the highest-grade single intercepts this season from any junior on the TSX Venture. The 2026 drill campaign at the fully-funded ML Project has now defined the Tess Zone over at least 200m along trend and 150m depth, with multiple high-grade structural intervals open in both directions, making this one of Yukon's more exciting high-grade gold discovery stories of the current cycle.

headline: ALL 25 HOLES HIT: GMV MINERALS COMPLETES MEXICAN HAT PROGRAM — 12.64 G/T OVER 4.88M ANCHORS 94-INTERCEPT CAMPAIGN
snippet: GMV Minerals (TSXV: GMV) released the final assays from its 2026 drill program at the Mexican Hat Gold Project in southeastern Arizona, with all 25 diamond drill holes returning significant gold mineralization — a 100% hit rate across 94 significant intervals averaging 0.87 g/t gold over 7.74 metres. Best hole MHC26-14 returned 12.64 g/t gold over 4.88 metres; the complete dataset positions Mexican Hat as one of the more de-risked early-stage gold targets in the southwestern U.S., with an underground porphyry at depth yet to be drilled.

headline: AWALÉ EXTENDS BBM OUTSIDE RESOURCE: 47M AT 2.2 G/T AUEQ — 44M AT 3.1 G/T AUEQ NEAR SURFACE IN CÔTE D'IVOIRE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Awalé Resources (TSXV: ARIC)
snippet: Awalé Resources (TSXV: ARIC) reported drill results extending the BBM gold-copper deposit at its Odienné Project in Côte d'Ivoire along strike and at depth, with BBDD-33 intersecting 47 metres of 2.2 g/t AuEq outside the current 1.71-million-ounce inferred resource, and a separate hole returning 44 metres of 3.1 g/t AuEq near surface. The results confirm that BBM remains open in multiple directions and that near-surface, open-pittable mineralization extends beyond the current resource envelope — setting up a meaningful resource update.

headline: NEWCORE GOLD GHANA: 1.16 G/T OVER 41M FROM 2M DEPTH — ENCHI NEAR-SURFACE BULK HIT EXPANDS SHALLOW FOOTPRINT
snippet: Newcore Gold (TSXV: NCAU) drilled 41.0 metres grading 1.16 g/t gold beginning just 2 metres below surface at its Enchi Gold Project in Ghana — a wide, near-surface interval that adds low-strip bulk tonnage to a project already targeting a 2027 PEA. Ghana's Enchi Gold Belt remains one of West Africa's most accessible exploration corridors, and consistently shallow gold intercepts like this support the open-pit economics Newcore is building toward.

headline: ROYAL ROAD MARGARITAS: HIGH-GRADE SILVER-GOLD-ANTIMONY VEIN SYSTEM GROWS — PORPHYRY SIGNAL IDENTIFIED IN COLOMBIA
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Royal Road Minerals (TSXV: RYR)
snippet: Royal Road Minerals (TSXV: RYR) expanded the high-grade silver-gold-antimony vein system at the Margaritas target in Colombia's Antioquia Province, reporting new drill results that extend the vein footprint while simultaneously advancing porphyry vectoring that links Margaritas to the company's nearby Güíntar copper-gold porphyry discovery. With antimony now designated a critical defence mineral by the U.S. and Canada, a project combining high-grade Ag-Au-Sb vein mineralization above a copper-gold porphyry presents a rare multi-metal target profile.

headline: SILVER NORTH WRAPS LARGEST HALDANE DRILL PROGRAM EVER — 6,169M COMPLETED NEXT TO HECLA'S PRODUCING KENO HILL MINE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Silver North Resources (TSXV: SNAG)
snippet: Silver North Resources (TSXV: SNAG) completed its 2026 drill program at the Haldane Silver Project in Yukon's Keno Hill Silver District, finishing 6,169 metres — the company's largest campaign to date, targeting Main Zone expansion and the Bighorn Target. Haldane sits immediately adjacent to Hecla Mining's operating Keno Hill silver mine, one of the highest-grade silver mines in North America; results from this expanded campaign will be a key re-rating catalyst as investors assess proximity and grade potential.

headline: TIGER GOLD FLIPS THREE RIGS TO CEIBAL AFTER TESORITO INFILL — 20,000M PROGRAM TARGETS Q1 2027 RESOURCE ESTIMATE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Tiger Gold (TSXV: TIGR)
snippet: Tiger Gold Corp. (TSXV: TIGR) announced the completion of 3,484 metres of infill and extension drilling at its Tesorito gold deposit — with 19 holes pending assay — and simultaneously confirmed three diamond drill rigs are now turning at its new Ceibal discovery, approximately 1km from Tesorito in Colombia's Mid-Cauca gold belt. Earlier Ceibal holes have returned 685m grading 0.6 g/t Au from surface; the escalated three-rig push signals management confidence in Ceibal's scale ahead of a maiden resource targeted for Q1 2027.

headline: FED MINUTES SIGNAL SEPTEMBER HIKE LIKELY ONE-OFF — GOLD HOLDS ABOVE $4,100 AS DECEMBER HIKE ODDS STAY AT 69%
snippet: The Federal Reserve released minutes from its September 15-16 meeting on October 7 — with the text suggesting the September 25-basis-point hike to 3.75–4% was not pre-committed to being followed by another — sending gold higher from its morning session low near $4,086. December gold futures had opened at $4,195 before reversing; markets now price a 78% probability the Fed holds unchanged on October 28, but a 69% chance of another 25bp hike in December. Silver retreated to $60.28/oz. Gold's $4,000 floor remains the key technical support.

headline: ONGOLD STARTS 2,100M PHASE 2 AT TPK — COPPER-SILVER-GOLD MASSIVE SULPHIDE ZONE IN NORTHERN ONTARIO NOW IN CROSSHAIRS
source_name: Junior Mining Network / ONGold Resources (TSXV: ONAU)
snippet: ONGold Resources (TSXV: ONAU) commenced a 2,100-metre Phase 2 diamond drill program at the TPK Project in Northern Ontario, following Phase 1 geophysics and mapping that defined priority targets at the Gold Ridge area — including the West Discovery Copper-Silver-Gold massive sulphide zone first intersected in 2025. Phase 2 is expected to continue through late November 2026; results are the next major catalyst for a company that went public on the TSX Venture in 2025 and is building its first drill-defined discovery.

headline: METALSOURCE LAUNCHES 1.1KM STEP-OUT AT SILVER HILL — NORTHERN TARGET COULD SUBSTANTIALLY EXPAND KNOWN FOOTPRINT
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Metalsource Mining (CSE: MSM)
snippet: Metalsource Mining Inc. (CSE: MSM) launched Phase 2 exploration drilling at Silver Hill with a major 1.1-kilometre northern step-out as the first priority target — designed to test whether the known Silver Hill mineralization system extends significantly beyond its current footprint. If mineralization extends along the full step-out distance, the target would substantially increase the project's scale potential and open additional follow-up targets to the north.

headline: HOCHSCHILD Q3 TOPS 70,000 GEO — STRONG GOLD/SILVER MARGINS CONFIRM FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE OF 291K-319K OUNCES
snippet: Hochschild Mining (LSE: HOC) confirmed its full-year production guidance of 291,000–319,000 gold equivalent ounces after a Q3 2026 output exceeding 70,000 GEO, with Inmaculada contributing approximately 50,000 ounces in the quarter (156,000 YTD) and Mara Rosa recovering after a brief earlier suspension. The company credited the high gold and silver price environment for substantially expanding margins versus 2025, with management noting that all-in sustaining costs are trending toward the lower end of the $1,980–$2,080/oz guidance band — a significant improvement in free cash flow generation.

headline: URANIUM ENERGY GOES MULTI-MINE: FY2026 Q4 PRODUCTION +157%, $93/LB REALIZED, $753M CASH — "TRANSFORMATIONAL" YEAR CONFIRMED
source_name: Timothy Sykes / Uranium Energy Corp (NYSE: UEC)
snippet: Uranium Energy Corp (NYSE: UEC) formally became a multi-mine U.S. uranium producer in fiscal 2026 (year ended July 31), growing from one mine in Wyoming to operations at Christensen Ranch (Wyoming) and Burke Hollow (Texas) simultaneously — with Q4 production of 82,744 lbs up 157% quarter-over-quarter and a peer-leading realized price of $93.13/lb. The company holds $753 million in liquid assets with zero debt and a strategic inventory of 1.26 million pounds of U₃O₈, positioning it as one of the best-capitalised uranium producers heading into the tightening supply cycle.
